title: Makati eats: Dillingers turns sweet 16 after some bitter years
summary: The Makati restaurant and bar, which opened in 2010, is celebrating its 16th anniversary this October with a refreshed menu, a new culinary direction, and plans to expand beyond its Greenbelt home.
